'''Jadefire Glen''' is an encampment of demonic [[satyr]] in southern [[Felwood]]. Many of the [[quest]]s in Felwood involve killing the satyr here and scattered throughout the rest of the corrupted [[wood]]s.

The path leading to Jadefire Glen begins at {{coords|44|84|Felwood}}.
